TOOLING BURST T4f — SPEC § 7 row "T4f — per-skill pierce + FULL/PARTIAL contact text (Matt 2026-09-15: no targeting protocol, CAST button stays, ranges unchanged)" (Run C-5, the VFX workflow run: effects that match the painted cliffside register). task_id "T4f".

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, and § 7 (the intro paragraph and the row "T4f — per-skill pierce + FULL/PARTIAL contact text (Matt 2026-09-15: no targeting protocol, CAST button stays, ranges unchanged)" — that row is your contract; its Acceptance column is how your work is measured).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. export/godot_import.py + the emitted scripts/vfx_g1.gd (T4b component), export/effect_kit.py (kit.json gains pierce), tests/test_vfx_picker.py (extend G1ComponentTests), tests/test_effect_kit.py (ONLY the one named test re-point), runs/C-5/cliffside_v19/ (read-only; export to runs/C-5/t3/T4f/), runs/C-5/t3/T4b/README.md (the component's interface).
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy (+ sklearn) ONLY; ffmpeg/ffprobe at /opt/homebrew/bin/.

BUILD exactly the SPEC row — every function named, with the named parameters and defaults, and its tests (unittest, stdlib) including the known-bad cases. Do NOT add any targeting, lock, cycle, tap-to-cast or range change — Matt struck them. Art step 1, LINEAR everywhere. Emit probe_pierce.gd for the conductor to run OUTSIDE the sandbox; in-sandbox Godot tests may be red — note it.
Then run the FULL suite: `cd /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B tests/run_t0c.py` — expected: all green except the named standing reds (the four T0-d3 motif reds: test_f04_outside_at_least_three + three test_named_genuine_annuli_retained subtests; test_synthetic_contract_and_grid; and test_k3_combat_report_only until T3c fixes it); report exact counts (tests_run, successful) and name every red.

DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, fixtures/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, anything under runs/ except runs/C-5/t3/T4f/, and any existing test file except where the SPEC row names a fix. Existing modules may be EXTENDED only as the row says (new parameters with backward-compatible defaults; the regression lock must stay green). Do not run git. Temporary files ONLY under tests/tmp/ or runs/C-5/t3/T4f/tmp/ (delete large temporaries — decoded video frames — before you return).
PRIORITY if time runs short: the instruments and their synthetic tests first, the real-clip acceptance second, polish never; deliver what is done with honest concerns rather than exceeding the cap.

RETURN: the receipt (task_id "T4f"): files = every file you created or modified (repo-absolute or burst-relative paths) with sha256; images []; calls_used 0; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED; concerns with numbers (every acceptance quantity: measured value vs the SPEC row's criterion; wall times; suite counts). Never PASS/FAIL.
